primary_profit_center.note: Different from balance_spot. balance_spot equalizes put/call expected loss on shorts only; profit_center maximizes modeled full-book mark-to-market P&L.

reality_test.limitations: Association only, not causation. IV, skew, theta, bid/ask, after-hours/stale quotes, and integer DTE all move between snaps. Observed MTM is POS marks, not the BS model. Unchanged-position pairs only (qty/strike/dte/side).
